title: Image Management
desc: Unified Docker image repository for Docker Swarm and K3s, supporting startup and on-demand Docker API discovery, layer inspection, category editing, node migration, and multi-node backup

pullModal.title: Download / Pull Docker Image
pullModal.subtitle: Pull Docker images from Docker Hub, Aliyun ACR, or private Harbor registries and deploy to target nodes
pullModal.imageNameRequired: Please enter full Docker image name
pullModal.targetNodePlaceholder: Select target node to pull image
pullModal.multiNodeRule: [Scheduling Policy] Multi-node cluster detected. The master node is preserved as the control plane; challenge images cannot be downloaded to the master node. Please select a resource node or broadcast to all resource nodes.
pullModal.singleNodeRule: [Single-Node Note] Only the master node currently exists; image will be downloaded directly to the master node.

transferModal.title: Image Node Transfer
transferModal.subtitle: Migrate the selected Docker image from its current node to another cluster node
transferModal.sourceNodePlaceholder: Select the source node where the image currently resides
transferModal.targetNodePlaceholder: Select the destination node to transfer to
transferModal.sameNodeError: Source node and destination node cannot be the same
transferModal.transferRule: The transfer will pull/deploy the image on the destination node, and remove it from the source node upon completion.

backupModal.title: Image Disaster Recovery & Backup
backupModal.subtitle: Create cross-node backup replicas or download offline image archive (.tar)
backupModal.targetNodePlaceholder: Select the cluster node to store the backup replica
backupModal.targetNodeRequired: Please select the target backup node
backupModal.nodeNotice: The image will be pulled to the destination node while retaining the original node copy for high availability.
backupModal.archiveNotice: The image tarball will be packaged and streamed directly to your browser download without consuming server disk space.
backupModal.exportSuccess: Image archive package exported and downloading successfully!

detailDrawer.subtitle: Inspect Docker Hub-compliant layer history (Layers), build commands, and container runtime environment configurations
detailDrawer.author: Author / Maintainer
detailDrawer.noLayers: No layers detected or underlying Docker history is unavailable

editTypeModal.title: Edit Image Category
editTypeModal.subtitle: Change category attribute of this Docker image in the cluster

deleteModal.title: Delete Docker Image
deleteModal.subtitle: Manage image physical presence across cluster nodes; remove from specific nodes or purge completely
deleteModal.multiNodeNotice: This image currently resides on {count} cluster nodes. You can remove it from specific nodes (preserving copies on other nodes) or delete it from all nodes.
deleteModal.singleNodeNotice: This image currently resides on a single node. Deletion will completely remove the image and its database metadata.
deleteModal.scopeSpecificDesc: Physically remove Docker image from selected nodes while keeping copies on remaining nodes
deleteModal.scopeAllDesc: Physically remove image from all cluster nodes and delete all database metadata
deleteModal.selectNodesRequired: Please select at least one node to clean
deleteModal.selectAllNodesWarning: Notice: All nodes are selected. Execution will completely purge all metadata records for this image
deleteModal.dangerWarning: High Risk Warning: Physical deletion commands will be dispatched to all cluster nodes, and metadata will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone!
deleteModal.successSpecific: Successfully cleaned image from selected node(s)!
deleteModal.successAll: Successfully purged image from all cluster nodes!
